## Goal
Make KinVue operable with Prometheus metrics on every service and Grafana dashboards.

## Scope
HTTP + WS metrics, Prometheus scrape config, Overview/Rooms/Media dashboards, observability runbook.

## Out of scope
Do not change business logic — instrumentation and dashboards only.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-611: Prometheus metrics for all services (HTTP + Rooms WS metrics)
2. KIN-612: Grafana dashboards: Overview, Rooms, Media
3. KIN-613: Write `docs/runbooks/observability.md`

- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md

## Goal
Harden KinVue against common attacks: validation, CORS, rate limits, CI scanning, security tests.

## Scope
Body limits, CORS allowlist, secret/dependency scanning, security test suite, security runbook.

## Out of scope
Do not add new features — hardening only.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-621: Input validation + body size limits on all external endpoints
2. KIN-622: CORS allowlist, secret scanning, dependency scanning in CI
3. KIN-623: Security tests: private room denial, viewer playback denial, admin guard, expired JWT, upload type denial
4. KIN-624: Write `docs/runbooks/security.md`

## Goal
Automated quality gate on every PR: lint, typecheck, unit/integration tests, Playwright smoke.

## Scope

## Out of scope

2. KIN-632: CI: Docker Compose integration tests + Playwright smoke

## Goal
Comprehensive automated coverage of user journeys, failure modes, and load baselines.

## Scope
20 E2E journeys, failure tests, load scripts, capacity documentation.

## Out of scope
Do not change production architecture — test and measure only.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-701: E2E suite: all 20 user journeys from implementation plan Phase 29
2. KIN-702: Failure tests: Gateway/Auth/Users/Rooms/Redis/Meilisearch/RabbitMQ/transcode scenarios
3. KIN-703: Load test scripts: Gateway, search, Rooms WS, chat, notifications, media
4. KIN-704: Document capacity results in `docs/runbooks/capacity-results.md`

## Goal
Deploy KinVue MVP to production within <= $300/month with smoke-tested Gateway, WS, and media.

## Scope
Production Dockerfiles, infra provisioning, deploy, migrations, deployment runbook.

## Out of scope
Do not target 100k concurrent users — MVP scale only.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-711: Production Dockerfiles + env documentation
2. KIN-712: Provision MVP infra (DBs, Redis, RabbitMQ, object storage, CDN) within <= $300/month budget
3. KIN-713: Deploy services + run migrations + smoke tests
4. KIN-714: Write `docs/runbooks/deployment.md`
